mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 7.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in recession risk.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial production growth above 0.5% month-over-month, the market interprets this as robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% m/m over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% indicates strong economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth falls below -0.5% month-over-month, it signals imminent economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO m/m falls below -0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and CPI inflation above 3.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening amid high inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.
